_doc: Human criterion (2026-08-27, dataset-v2): the slot splitter of the original extractor recognised only twelve header prefixes, so every other label line the professional writes inside a diet was appended to whatever slot was open. This file classifies the 160 label families found in dataset-v1 (3.221 occurrences, 8.490 catalogue components). Rules are applied in the order below, first match wins; the regexes run against the label with parentheses, times, digits and decoration stripped, upper-cased and accent-free.

_categories.A: a real eating occasion -> its block MOVES to the target slot
_categories.B: a category header INSIDE the meal (supplements, macro sub-lists, recipe helpers) -> block STAYS (parse_items.HEADER_LABELS already drops the prefix)
_categories.C: an alternative version of the same meal (TIPO 1/2, OPCIÓN 1/2, DÍA 2, CARGA) -> block STAYS; declared bias: the options are counted cumulatively although they are exclusive
_categories.D: prose (observations, advice, water instructions) -> block moves to the diet's notes; today it is parsed as an instruction and DROPPED
_categories.E: signature residue and training content leaked into a diet document -> block dropped
_categories.F: residual long tail not covered by the lexicon -> left untouched and declared
